dedupe_keys.name: the effect of flood exposure on insurance adoption among us households

description: The flood-insurance study authors publish tract and county panel tables and scripts for United States households. Zenodo supplies six CSV files and one R analysis script free under CC BY 4.0. File names identify flood exposure, insurance adoption, National Flood Insurance Program claims and historical disaster costs, including a county panel spanning 2005–2020. These variables can inform household uptake and financial-vulnerability assumptions in flood-risk simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this panel package. Coverage is aggregated U.S. geographies and the article’s study period, not property-level insurance decisions. The public summary gives little dictionary detail, and inferred relationships between exposure and adoption may reflect policy, pricing or selection effects. Insurance claims do not measure all physical flood losses. No CSV was downloaded, regression rerun or policy effect asserted.
